## Overview
The Kleynenberg Perspective (TKP) is an independent, ad-free, self-hosted audio broadcast exploring Artificial Intelligence architectures, computational linguistics, cognitive systems, and digital sovereignty. Syndicated via podsync v2.8.0 to a static RSS 2.0 feed without tracking or dynamic ad injection.

- Episode 02 (16:05): Human-Machine Partnership: Integrity Headers & Verifiable AI
- Episode 01 (12:40): Pure Signal, Zero Static: Inaugural Broadcast
